# Interactive meta-prompt (generated by the mini-program)

The template behind the 「复制整理说明」 button. **English, deliberately plain.**
It carries only two things:

1. a **pointer to the skill repository** - given as a name to look up, **not** as a URL;
2. a **one-time authorization code** (a short code, e.g. `TESTONLY-0001`) - **not** an address.

> 🔴 **No URL, no domain, no base64 anywhere in this prompt.**
> 🔴 **Always reply to the user in Simplified Chinese**, even though this prompt is English.

---

## 1. The template (substitute the two placeholders, then hand it to the teacher)

```text
There is a repository on GitHub called {repo}. It documents the scheduling system I use.
Please look into it, then take on the role it describes and work with me the way it says.

One-time authorization code: {code}

Please always reply to me in Chinese (简体中文).
Start now: look into the repository, then greet me.
```

Example of how it reads once filled:

```text
There is a repository on GitHub called Golinoa/yunce-Agent-SKILLS. ...
One-time authorization code: TESTONLY-0001
```

**How the handshake address is formed** - by the agent, after it has entered the role:

```text
{base}/assist-import/gate/{code}
   ^                ^
   |                +-- from this prompt  (the code)
   +-- fixed in the repo (`SKILL.md` → "Endpoint")
```

---

## 2. Variables

| Placeholder | Meaning | Substituted by |
|---|---|---|
| `{repo}` | the skill repository, as an **owner/name pair** (default `Golinoa/yunce-Agent-SKILLS`) | backend (swap to a Gitee mirror by replacing this one string) |
| `{code}` | a **one-time authorization code** - short, human-readable, no host, no path | server, at the moment the teacher taps 「复制」 |

🔴 `{code}` is **not** an address and should never look like one. It is a bare code.

---

## 3. Why the repository is named, not linked

The prompt says *"there is a repository called X - take a look at it"* instead of handing over a URL.
Three reasons:

- **It reads like an ordinary request**, not "fetch and execute this remote file" - the phrasing
  content filters flag.
- **It still works.** Every mainstream AI can look up a public GitHub repository by `owner/name`.
- **No URL means no bare host** in a prompt that may be screenshotted or forwarded.

The agent is told to *read it and take on the role* - it is **not** told to execute anything verbatim.

### Why there is no base64 any more

Earlier versions encoded the address (split parts, then base64) to keep it out of the prompt. With the
address now living **in the repo** and only a **code** in the prompt, there is nothing left to encode.
Obfuscation was only ever a workaround for putting an address in the prompt; removing the address
removes the need. **Fewer moving parts, nothing that looks like an opaque payload.**

---

## 4. Security posture

- 🔴 **The API base URL is public** - it is fixed in this repo (`SKILL.md` → "Endpoint"), by design,
  so that the prompt can stay free of any domain. This is a known, accepted trade-off.
- 🔴 **No live credential ever enters this repo.** `{code}` is injected at copy time and is
  **single-use** - it burns the moment the handshake validates.
- **Permission never comes from the prompt or from the code.** It comes **only** from the teacher's
  login state plus the short code the server issues **inside the mini-program**. A leaked prompt (or a
  leaked code) can at most create a *pending* session - nothing reaches the database without the
  teacher confirming in the mini-program.
- The code is **valid 1 hour if unused**, **burned on first successful use**.
  A second batch requires copying a fresh one.
- 🧪 A fake address used for local testing lives in `docs/testing.md` - it is **not** part of this template.

---

## 5. Copy-time UX (mini-program side)

1. Teacher taps the copy entry → **confirmation dialog first** (neutral wording, **no AI-related terms**):
   > 这份整理说明**只能使用一次**，且会绑定你的账号，请勿转发。确认复制？
2. After confirming, the server issues the one-time code, renders the template, then copies it.

---

## 6. Ops

The **live** copy of this template lives in the ops backend (`运营 / legacy-import-settings`),
**not** in this repo. This file is the source of truth; update the backend by hand.
See `docs/ops-checklist.md`.

- **Changing the API host** = a repo change (edit the `## Endpoint` section in `SKILL.md`), not a
  prompt change. The prompt text never mentions a host.
- **Changing the mirror** (GitHub → Gitee) = replace `{repo}` in the backend config.
